what_happened.line: The Open Space Committee voted by roll call to table its recommendation on the 360 Flat Hill Road orchard and ask selectmen for more time to explore a low-cost way to protect the farmland.
The chair will pursue land trust and conservation buyer options for 360 Flat Hill Road and report back at the next meeting.
Members will each review the general municipal parcels before the next meeting, and one member will ask the assessor for a list of all municipal-owned properties.
Marshall Park master planning and grants will be a recurring agenda item, with the committee acting as grant liaison for the parks commission.
The next meeting moved from Nov 17 to Tuesday Nov 24 at 6 pm.

why_it_matters: The 360 Flat Hill Road orchard is a 23-acre parcel in farm-use tax status, and the committee did not recommend either way, so its future is undecided; members doubted town meeting would fund a purchase, which leaves land trusts or conservation buyers as the route to keeping it as farmland.
Park grants reimburse only part of the cost after the work is done, so a Marshall Park project would require town meeting to appropriate the full cost up front, contingent on the grant.
